Name: Smaller Mouse Cursors
Author: Fuzzlepuzzle
Description:
Just a small mod that makes the cursors significantly smaller and less obtrusive. The hand which is on some icons is replaced with a mouse.

There's a config file to choose different colors, the shape of the cursor, and to toggle the border on or off. See images tab for examples. I always suggest using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], but note that you'll have to use the scroll wheel when selecting your color. The change won't appear until you load your save or change the game's language, since it has to refresh.

Hope you enjoy!

[size=2]Most of the art was not made by me, but the author gave me permission to upload and maintain the mod.
Inspiration drawn from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2856]Tiny Cursor[/url].[/size]
